summary.current_focus: Evaluation structure, viewer evidence, and guardrail contraction
summary.recent_pattern: Recent commits mostly tightened tests, benchmark-viewer data, and evidence-policy guardrails instead of advancing model benchmark execution.
summary.reflection: This is useful only while it prevents false paper-readiness claims. Future work should spend more slices on running or fixing benchmark model paths and less on pinning individual JSON rows.
summary.test_strategy: Keep one broad viewer contract check plus focused generator and policy tests. Avoid sparse row-by-row tests for every imported artifact unless the exact row is part of a public contract.

work_focus.notes: The last visible slice is dominated by tests and guardrails. Only one recent commit directly changed CUDA execution behavior.
